newsitem.title: USA: Neb. legislative panel advances $56 mln tax cut.
newsitem.headline: Neb. legislative panel advances $56 mln tax cut.

text.p: A Nebraska legislative committee has approved a bill to provide $56 million in income tax relief for each of the next two years, legal counsel to the committee said Friday.
Nebraskans would receive a three percent income tax cut and an increase in personal exemption credits under the recommendation passed by the revenue committee on Thursday, George Kilpatrick said.
The proposal must next be considered by the full legislature, which also is considering a proposed $100 million property tax cut, Kilpatrick noted.
Nebraska Gov. Ben Nelson proposed cutting the income and property taxes in January, citing a projected state budget surplus.
The property tax proposal is scheduled to be debated in the legislature later in April, Kilpatrick said.
